description: Unit test class for the Basket entity in the Shopping cart system, testing the AddItem functionality including addition, incrementing, defaults, and exception cases.

classes.name: BasketAddItem
classes.description: Test class for Basket entity's AddItem method, verifying correct behavior and handling of edge cases.

methods.name: AddsBasketItemIfNotPresent
methods.description: Tests adding a new item to the basket when the item is not already present.

methods.name: IncrementsQuantityOfItemIfPresent
methods.description: Tests that adding the same item increases its quantity rather than adding a duplicate.

methods.name: KeepsOriginalUnitPriceIfMoreItemsAdded
methods.description: Ensures that the unit price remains consistent when additional quantities of the same item are added.

methods.name: DefaultsToQuantityOfOne
methods.description: Checks that if quantity is not specified, it defaults to 1.

methods.name: CantAddItemWithNegativeQuantity
methods.description: Verifies that adding an item with a negative quantity throws an ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

methods.name: CantModifyQuantityToNegativeNumber
methods.description: Checks that attempting to add an item with a negative quantity after initial addition throws an exception.
